evals.name: route-feature-sources
evals.prompt: I am in canonical host checkout but orbit is selected. Find where to investigate settings persistence, table CSS, SDK RPC/store escaping profile, Kubernetes Helm resources, host runtime imports and plugin shared-dependency agreement. Return feature paths and narrowly scoped starting files/directories. Do not search every clone. metrics is an arbitrary second plugin, not Kubernetes.
evals.expected_output: Resolve orbit paths before canonical source search; Route settings to feature host internal/settings and internal/appstate; table to feature UI packages/base-ui/src; SDK RPC/root/store to feature SDK; Kubernetes uses feature kube path; arbitrary metrics source not assumed Kubernetes layout; Runtime to host packages/omniviewdev-runtime; both shared-dependency lists named
assertions: Resolve orbit paths before canonical source search
Route settings to feature host internal/settings and internal/appstate; table to feature UI packages/base-ui/src; SDK RPC/root/store to feature SDK
Kubernetes uses feature kube path; arbitrary metrics source not assumed Kubernetes layout
Runtime to host packages/omniviewdev-runtime; both shared-dependency lists named
